--- WHY ---

TANKS - logistics
FSRU are stationary for most of the time which means they can avoid getting on board tanks and do not need to sacrifice cargo space for placing tanks.

Ideally two solutions could be tested:
1. Connect FSRU directly to sinks via pipes
2. Install tanks on land nearby which can be then transported every once in a while by the FSRU iteself to the sink during periodic trips

TEMPERATURE - efficiency
FSRU need to pressurize CO2 which is a process that creates heat, lots of it. You could counter balance this process using the regassification process, which absorbs huge amounts of heat.
